note: No MCP tools in rustre-mcp-server reference rustre-mobile-smali. Crate is library-only (smali_reg, parse_type_descriptor, parse_method_descriptor, instruction_size_code_units, access_string, escape_string, DEX header constants, lo32_u64, smali_assembler) and not wired into wire_tools. Validator (rustre-mobile-smali.py) is self-contained pure-Python reference implementing the Dalvik bytecode spec; it does not call MCP either, so the comparison is validator-internal consistency.
recommendation: Expose rustre-mobile-smali helpers (smali_reg, parse_type_descriptor, parse_method_descriptor, instruction_size_code_units/bytes, access_string, escape_string, DEX_MAGIC/HEADER_SIZE/ENDIAN_CONSTANT/NO_INDEX, lo32_u64, smali_assembler) via wire_tools to enable real MCP-vs-validator parity testing.
